bounded_repository_inventory.documentation_interpretation: The only direct public-search-attention and query-basket matches are Campaign271's own concept-only preregistration and result. Other issuer/brand/product, platform/archive and zero-denominator matches are immutable prior lifecycle/source-frontier documents, not an accepted public-search source, point-in-time identity master, query basket, archive, adapter or source manifest.
bounded_repository_inventory.method: Frozen rg query families over tracked file names and repository text/JSON metadata only; Campaign272 files were excluded and no raw or derived source row was opened.

contract_gate_results.name: point_in_time_issuer_brand_product_identity
contract_gate_results.reason: No accepted local historical listed-instrument/legal-entity/subsidiary/brand/product/trademark identity master with ownership intervals, corporate actions, public clocks and revision provenance exists.

contract_gate_results.name: prevalue_query_basket_identity_and_ambiguity
contract_gate_results.reason: No immutable point-in-time issuer-specific query basket, alias/language map, generic-term ambiguity rule or collision/exclusion contract exists outside Campaign271's null concept placeholder.

contract_gate_results.name: fixed_search_platform_geography_and_sampling_population
contract_gate_results.reason: No accepted local contract fixes one search platform, geography, device/population, sampling frame, metric definition and normalization for the entire historical campaign.

contract_gate_results.name: immutable_2019_2023_search_observation_archive
contract_gate_results.reason: No repository script, tracked source manifest or accepted artifact implements an immutable reproducible public-search-attention archive covering 2019-2023.

contract_gate_results.name: public_availability_sampling_and_revision_clock
contract_gate_results.reason: Without an accepted identity, query and observation source, signal-close availability, release delay, sampling changes, corrections and non-backfilled revision semantics cannot be bound.

contract_gate_results.name: complete_all_issuer_zero_missing_denominator
contract_gate_results.reason: True zero search attention cannot be separated from missing, unsupported, suppressed or outage coverage for every point-in-time eligible issuer. Comparable all-issuer support is therefore unproven.

contract_gate_results.name: later_formula_direction_support_and_walkforward_protocol
contract_gate_results.reason: Because gates one through six fail, no exact query aggregation, formula, direction, support rule, t+1/t+3 clock or frozen 2019-2023 walk-forward protocol can be bound before rows without post-source search.

decision.next_safe_work: Campaign273 may scout one genuinely independent finite concept before values. It must not switch to website traffic, app-store metrics, ecommerce demand, job postings, social discussion, alternative query baskets, search platforms, geographies, sampling windows, thresholds or directions as a rescue of Campaign271/272.
decision.reason: The preregistered conjunctive contract requires all seven components. Every component is absent or not bindable in accepted local repository metadata, so public-search-attention concept c271_01 cannot become a factor.

timestamp_semantics: Monotonic logical publication time after the Campaign272 inventory; not a market-data timestamp or host-wall-clock claim.
